parts.script:
Tom: Hey Sarah, have you thought about our weekend getaway yet?  
Sarah: Yeah, I was thinking we could head to the mountains. It would be nice to escape the city for a bit.  
Tom: That sounds great! Do you have any specific place in mind?  
Sarah: I heard about a cozy cabin near Lakeview. It has a beautiful view and some hiking trails nearby.  
Tom: Perfect! How do we get there?  
Sarah: It’s about a two-hour drive from here. We could leave early Saturday morning.  
Tom: Sounds good. Should we bring any food or drinks along?  
Sarah: Definitely! I can pack some sandwiches and snacks for the road.  
Tom: And maybe we can stop by the local market on the way for fresh fruits and drinks?  
Sarah: Great idea! I also want to bring some board games for the evening.  
Tom: I’ll bring my guitar too. We can have a little music session by the fire.  
Sarah: That will be so much fun! Let’s finalize the plan later this week.  
Tom: Agreed! I'm really looking forward to it.  
Sarah: Me too! It will be a nice break.
